attempts.text:
**The window starts on a single spine column.** Column 0, `holE`, is carried by 100% of chromosomes, persistent, and in a region of plasticity in 0% of calls. The model names it in 99% of calls, with 0.03 bits.

**Then 79 fork and variable columns follow**, in a region of plasticity in 0.2 to 80% of calls. A second branch of 26 families runs through columns 1 to 26, carried by 11% of chromosomes, all persistent: `yobB` to `yecD`, [[carbon and zinc handling]]. The most carried families there are `yobA` to `manX`, persistent, 85 to 89%: `manZ`, `manY` and `manX` form a [[mannose transport system]].

**Columns 27 to 42 are variable**, 76 to 87%, mostly persistent: `yoaL` to `yeaW`, including `pdeD`, `sdaA` and `fadD`. Then `dmlA` and `dmlR` at columns 43 and 44, and `leuE` at 45. Columns 47 to 70 are variable again, 67 to 87%: `yoaG` to `ydjK`, with `gapA` and `msrB` among them.

**The model hesitates most at column 70**, `ydjK`, 0.90 bits, in a region of plasticity in 72% of calls, and names it in 59%. Column 71, `ydjJ`, follows at 0.84 bits, 80%. The 13 columns mostly in a region of plasticity: named 80%, 0.53 bits; the other 67: named 96%, 0.25 bits. Inside a region of plasticity the model hesitates more than outside, 0.93 against 0.17 bits, and names fewer genes, 71% against 98%.

**The window ends in fork and variable columns.** Columns 72 to 76, all shell, 71 to 78%: `ydjI` to `ydjE`. Then `pncA`, `ansA` and `sppA` at columns 77 to 79, persistent, 82%, 74% and 60%; a second branch of 3 families, `selD` to `gdhA`, is carried by 11 to 24%.

label: holE
facts:
WINDOW: the holE window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor holE, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 1,892 to 1,971 from dnaA. Read in 539 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying holE once); 43,120 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 93% of genes, 0.30 bits on average (perplexity 1.4 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 35,494 calls, named 99%, 0.16 bits; shell 7,343 calls, named 69%, 0.83 bits; cloud 283 calls, named 6%, 4.16 bits. Outside an RGP 35,743 calls, named 98%, 0.17 bits; inside an RGP 7,377 calls, named 71%, 0.93 bits. Columns: 1 spine, 32 fork, 47 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.93 against 0.17 bits) and names fewer genes (71% against 98%); 7,377 of the 43,120 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 70 (ydjK) 0.90 bits, RGP 72%; column 71 (ydjJ) 0.84 bits, RGP 80%; column 5 (yebW) 0.81 bits, RGP 3%. The 13 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 80%, 0.53 bits on average; the other 67 columns: named 96%, 0.25 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 1-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 0.2-80%; the least: column 0 (spine), RGP 0%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: holE. named 99%; 0.03 bits.
2. columns 1-79 (79 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 0.2-80%. named 59-99% (mean 93%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 70, named 59%, 0.90 bits.
